args.subject: Private Dining Table Request for 12 – Friday, May 24, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a private-dining table for 12 guests on Friday, May 24, 2024.

Could you please let me know your availability that evening and share the options for seating times? We would be interested in a dinner service, ideally around 7:00 PM, but we are flexible to accommodate whatever works best for you.

For reference, the restaurant is located at 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France.

Reservation details:
- Restaurant: New Asiaway
- Date: Friday, May 24, 2024
- Party size: 12 guests
- Occasion: Private group dinner
- Preferred time: Around 7:00 PM (flexible)

Contact details:
- Name: Emma Johnson
- Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
- Phone: 327-420-4923

Please confirm the reservation and any deposit or menu requirements at your earliest convenience. Thank you, and we look forward to dining with you.

Kind regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
